title: The backend correctly supports page/limit with a real total, and the header shows 'Loaded X of Y findings' using that real total - but nothing in the UI ever increments pagination.page or wires a page-change callback into CustomTable. CustomTable's own Prev/Next pager only paginates within the already-fetched slice (client-side).
description: Any scan with more findings than the selected page size (max 100) permanently hides all findings beyond the first page from the on-screen table - e.g. header says 'Loaded 100 of 3,482 findings' but there is no way to reach finding #101+.

category: Wrong data source - export ignores filters
title: handleExport's request body only ever sends {format, includeFindings:true, includeRemediation:true} - none of the on-screen severity/status/provider/service/region/search filters are forwarded, and the backend has no parameters for most of them anyway (only an unused severityFilter body field).
description: A user filters the on-screen table to e.g. 'Critical + FAIL + us-east-1' for an audit evidence pack, clicks Export, and the exported PDF/CSV/Excel/JSON silently contains EVERY finding in the scan, unfiltered - not the reviewed subset they intended to hand over.
tags: verified-note: Yes - confirmed request body has no filter fields

component: Scan Comparison modal (reached from scan history on scans/[scanId] flow)
title: The backend only computes improved/regressed COUNTS at the summary level but never attaches a per-finding changeType field to individual 'changed' entries. The frontend's badge logic is `finding.changeType === 'improved' ? 'BETTER' (green) : 'WORSE' (orange)` - since changeType is always undefined, every changed finding renders as orange 'WORSE', including ones that improved FAIL->PASS.
description: Compare two scans where 10 checks moved FAIL->PASS (real fixes) and 2 moved PASS->FAIL (real regressions) - the 'Status Changed' tab shows all 12 rows tagged 'WORSE' in orange, misrepresenting fixed issues as new problems.
tags: verified-note: Not independently re-verified (not in my spot-check sample)
